g.text: Class structure: browser capabilities and HTTP clients
marker: the browser driver runs JavaScript
The page client is a capability, because only
a BrowserKit session has one. The detached and
bare clients exist under every browser driver,
so a factory builds them instead.
Headers and credentials go to the base_url
host only. Cookies go to the host they were
page when the session has it
applies site options to base_url only,
and a client's own options over them
on a client of its own, as Mink does
